quarterly_data.signal: 6-K (Q1 2026 reviewed consolidated financial statements, segment note): revenue from external customers for the three months ended March 31, 2026 was NT$88,981,223 thousand in packaging (NT$68,411,481 thousand a year earlier), NT$21,041,056 thousand in testing (NT$16,004,385 thousand) and NT$61,361,398 thousand in EMS (NT$61,859,742 thousand); segment profit before income tax was NT$11,201,406 thousand in packaging and NT$5,629,098 thousand in testing.
quarterly_data.figure: Q1 2026 packaging NT$88,981,223 thousand (vs NT$68,411,481 thousand); testing NT$21,041,056 thousand (vs NT$16,004,385 thousand)

quarterly_data.signal: 6-K (Q1 2026 financial statements): outstanding commitments to purchase property, plant and equipment were approximately NT$219,584,143 thousand as of March 31, 2026 (NT$135,247,923 thousand at December 31, 2025), of which NT$19,749,238 thousand had been paid; additions to property, plant and equipment in Q1 2026 were NT$55,968,334 thousand (NT$42,674,148 thousand in Q1 2025), and construction in progress and machinery under installation stood at NT$80,289,052 thousand.
quarterly_data.figure: PP&E purchase commitments NT$219,584,143 thousand at March 31, 2026 (NT$135,247,923 thousand at December 31, 2025)

quarterly_data.signal: 6-K (subsequent events): in April 2026 ASE's board resolved to purchase plants and facilities in the Southern Taiwan Science Park from a third party for approximately NT$14,850,000 thousand (excluding tax), and SPIL's board resolved to purchase plants and facilities there from third parties for approximately NT$6,480,000 thousand and NT$4,320,000 thousand (excluding tax), to meet future capacity expansion.
quarterly_data.figure: Southern Taiwan Science Park plants: ASE ~NT$14,850,000 thousand; SPIL ~NT$6,480,000 thousand and NT$4,320,000 thousand

quarterly_data.signal: 6-K: in March 2026 ASE Electronics (M) Sdn. Bhd. entered into a share purchase agreement with Linear Technology Pte Ltd. to acquire Analog Devices Sdn. Bhd. (Malaysia), and completed the acquisition of 100% of its shares in May 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: 100% of Analog Devices Sdn. Bhd. acquired, May 2026

quarterly_data.signal: 6-K (Q1 2026 financial statements, commitments note): the Group has entered into long-term purchase agreements of materials and supplies with suppliers that specify minimum purchase quantities, and long-term agreements with customers under which it receives advance payments (recorded under other current liabilities and other liabilities) and is obligated to sell products or provide services; it also has long-term corporate power purchase agreements with suppliers.
